description.zh:
字段名。您可调用接口[ListSensitiveColumns](~~188103~~)获取该参数的值。
>您也可以通过调用接口[ListColumns](~~141870~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en:
The name of the sensitive field. You can call the [ListSensitiveColumns](~~188103~~) operation to query the name of the sensitive field.

> You can also call the [ListColumns](~~141870~~) operation to query the name of the sensitive field.

description.zh: 实例ID。您可调用[ListInstances](~~141936~~)或[GetInstance](~~141567~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the instance. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。
description.en: The page number of the returned page.
The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh:
数据库名。您可调用接口[SearchDatabase](~~141876~~)获取该参数的值。
>您也可以调用接口[ListDatabases](~~141873~~)获取物理库的SchemaName值，调用接口[ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~)获取逻辑库的SchemaName值。
description.en:
The database name. You can also call the [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~) operation to query the name of the database.

> You can also call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to query the value of the SchemaName parameter of a physical database, or the [ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~) operation to query the value of the SchemaName parameter of a logical database.

description.zh:
表名。您可通过调用接口[ListSensitiveColumns](~~188103~~)获取该参数的值。
>您也可以通过调用接口[ListTables](~~141878~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en:
The name of the table. You can call the [ListSensitiveColumns](~~188103~~) operation to query the table name.

> You can also call the [ListTables](~~141878~~) operation to query the table name.

description.zh:
租户的ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

title.zh: 获取敏感字段的脱敏算法相关信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-sensitive-column-info --instance-id 1830000 --schema-name test_schema --table-name test_table --column-name test_column --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --tid 3000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise ListSensitiveColumnInfo --region cn-hangzhou --TableName test_table --ColumnName test_column --PageSize 100 --InstanceId 1830000 --PageNumber 1 --SchemaName test_schema --Tid 3000
